text:
maria: Quick thread for tomorrow's design sync — prototype for an inline 'quiet periods' row in the alert preview. Goal: compress vertical space and make suppression windows scannable. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/qp-row.png

anil: Strong 👍 on compacting. Accessibility concerns: ensure a linear reading order, aria-labels for each window, and keyboard focus styling. Don't rely on color alone to indicate overlaps.

lisa: Copy tweak: use 'Quiet periods' instead of 'Suppressions' in UI copy. Helper text: 'Temporarily pause notifications for selected channels.'

devin: Perf note: rendering one segment per channel can blow up. Suggest grouping by medium (Pager / Email / Slack) and showing counts. Backend can return groupedCounts to avoid extra fetches.
jake: Keyboard behavior: roving tabindex, left/right to move, enter to edit. Use aria-posinset/aria-setsize so SRs get position context.
maria: Mobile fallback: show a compact pill ("3 channels quiet") that expands to a bottom sheet with the timeline. No hover-only reveals.
lisa: UX nit: badge auto-snoozed periods with an icon + tooltip that explains why it fired. 

maria: Action items: maria -> mobile mock; anil -> a11y checklist; lisa -> copy strings; devin -> API suggestion for groupedCounts; jake -> keyboard spec. I'll upload mocks later today.
